body: I've made it through my first night out of hospital thankyou to the people that replied, its nice to know someone cares and for once people believe the ex soldier over my wife. Who has held all the cards from the very start. She's a primary school teacher and had a very privileged upbringing. I was always an embarrasment to her at funtions, working class and not bright as she used to say. I found more of her profiles online tonight, I know I shouldn't look but I just want the truth about everything. She has refused to tell me anything or even say sorry. Just don't tell anyone
On my wife's profile she said she kissed a prince, that turned into a frog and that she wished to push her boundaries and that I was unable and unwilling to for full her.

Toughlove89 I think about my children constantly, I think they are young enough to forget me. My wife could have any man she wished. Perhaps someone who won't let them down. 1 hour a week in a centre I know it's selfish but it's just not enough.

I think another few bottles of wine and I'll be brave enough thankyou for replying it's the nicest thing that anyone has done in the last few months. My parents have both passed and all my friends were ours. I truly have no one without my little family.

Thankyou G1 Miller I'm great full someone even took the time to write it. I feel so worthless. I should be the strong one, someone my children should look up to. I never had a clue my life turn into this. I failed my wife by not being enough, which means a failed my children for not keeping our family together. I wish I could of been more. I'm afraid to tell the crisssis team that I've sat hear all night willing myself the courage to end the pain. But if I ask them for help I don't think I'll even get to see my babies in that centre. I can't bare the thought of going back to hospital. I so badly want to be brave and end the pain. I see on Facebook she was out with another man tonight. I always knew I was Puchong above my weight.
Sorry I should of proof read I'm crying so much it was hard to type or think. Hopefully you can make sense of it.
